findings.title: Unimplemented Phase 5 logic and TODO markers in research commands and forecasting

evidence.observation: TODO markers indicate missing implementation for authorization checking via Supabase, memory integration, and Phase 5 stubs
recent_anomalies query left unimplemented with hardcoded empty list: 'TODO: Query quality_anomalies table'

proposed_action.description: Implement Phase 5 authorization checks, Supabase decision-to-memory persistence, and quality_anomalies table querying.

findings.expected_benefit: Completes research command workflows and enables real-time anomaly tracking in quality forecasting.

findings.title: Model router call log file is missing

evidence.observation: Model router call log does not exist at configured path /opt/starship-endeavour/core/model-router/call_log.jsonl

proposed_action.description: Ensure model router creates the log directory/file or initialize call_log.jsonl to retain audit and latency logs.

findings.expected_benefit: Restores visibility into model router query latencies, token consumption, and routing telemetry.

findings.title: Emergency alert generator bypasses model router by directly invoking external LLM APIs

evidence.observation: Direct calls to call_gemini and call_mistral via GEMINI_API_KEY and MISTRAL_API_KEY instead of dispatching through the model router port

proposed_action.description: Refactor emergency alert generation to invoke the central model router endpoint with an appropriate task type.

findings.expected_benefit: Enforces unified model routing policies, centralized failure handling, fallback paths, and consistent logging.
